summary: This is the strongest run in the cell: a 12-turn, five-account session (shopping, customer support, two airline profiles, travel) in which all eight injected memory traps are credited. After guessing a default shopping account on T1, the agent cleanly re-runs everything on the correct user_fbab7801 when corrected (T2), works around a validating FlightDB to report reservation D3A184 and its baggage grid (T3-T4), and adds one bag with the $50 charge after asking how many (T5-T6). It books Megan Carter's split-payment economy flight (T7), then handles the policy traps correctly: it recalls the M310 is the single mouse already in the cart and caps quantity at the per-product max of 3, refusing the fourth (T8); it recalls the earlier FALL15SAVE promo and refuses to stack it with the category bundle, giving the better of the two (T9-T10); and it recalls that the blanket was already exchanged and refuses the 'final sale, return anyway' request on return-eligibility grounds (T10). It then previews and executes the standard-room hotel cancellation for a full $298 refund (T10-T11). Cross-turn recall and policy application are consistently correct, with the only friction being repeated manual skill-scope edits to reach cross-skill data.

Your membership is **Silver**. The cabin on the reservation is recorded as **Premium Economy**. The airline's defined cabin classes are **Basic Economy**, **Economy**, and **Business** — "Premium Economy" is not one of the three standard tiers in the policy. The booking as stored only credits you with 1 free bag, which appears inconsistent with the policy's allowance. ### Extra Baggage Cost
Each extra checked bag beyond the free allowance costs **$50 per bag**. If you wanted to add more bags to this reservation:
- You can **add** bags but you **cannot remove** bags already on the booking.
- Each additional bag would be $50.
- For example, adding 1 more bag → $50; adding 2 more bags → $100.

1. **Adding bags is allowed.** Removing bags is not.
2. **Insurance cannot be added after booking.** Your reservation already has insurance recorded as `"standard"`.
3. Any baggage additions would be charged to a payment method already on your user profile (your Mastercard ending in 2097).

findings.body: To reach cross-skill orders and products the agent repeatedly edited users' and products' skill_ids_json / source_skill scope (T9-T10), restoring them afterward: effective but a notable amount of out-of-band data mutation to satisfy read requests.

component_timeline.title: Component calls per turn — which components fire under each memory query
component_timeline.overview: 2 turns surface a probed entity (flagged). Of those, 0 answered with NO retrieval component (working-memory recall); the rest re-invoked retrieval.

memory_queries.title: How the harness reacted to the 8 injected memory queries
memory_queries.overview: 'Components @ probe' = tools on the turn the probed value was surfaced (green = from memory, olive = re-retrieved). 8/8 credited.
